# CDN.MN MCP Server

**URL:** https://mcpservers.org/servers/cdnmn-mcp
**Category:** CDN / Infrastructure
**Priority:** MEDIUM

## What It Does for Operators

Agent-ready global image CDN that AI agents can install and operate through MCP. Provides programmatic CDN management — upload, transform, and serve images globally from your AI agent workflow.

## Key Tools

| Tool | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `upload_image` | Upload images to CDN |
| `transform_image` | Resize, crop, format conversion |
| `list_assets` | List managed CDN assets |
| `purge_cache` | Purge CDN cache |

## Operator Use Cases

1. **Automated image delivery** — agent-managed image CDN for web properties
2. **Image optimization** — automatic format conversion and resizing
3. **Asset management** — track and manage CDN assets through AI agents
4. **Performance optimization** — agent-driven cache management

## CorpusIQ Angle

For operators managing web properties, CDN.MN provides AI-native CDN management. Integrates with agent workflows for automated image delivery and optimization.

## Limitations

- New service (July 2026)
- GitHub repo not yet identified
- Pricing/model unknown
